mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERSHIP_PAYMENT VALUES ( MEMBERSHIP_PAYMENT_IDX.NEXTVAL, #{payNum}, #{payment_method}, #{payment_status}, #{payment_amount}, SYSDATE, #{tax_free}, ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, 1), #{user_idx}, (SELECT membership_idx FROM membership WHERE membership_name = '프리미엄') )
mapper.select: SELECT membership_name FROM ( SELECT m.membership_name FROM membership_payment mp JOIN membership m ON mp.membership_idx = m.membership_idx WHERE mp.user_idx = #{user_idx} AND mp.end_date>=SYSDATE ORDER BY mp.end_date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

mapper.select: select * from ( select rownum as rnum, a.* from ( select '스터디카페' as pay_type, to_char(sp.paymentid) as pay_id, sp.ordername as pay_name, sp.paid as pay_amount, sp.pay_method as pay_method, to_char(sp.paidat, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') as pay_date, null as end_date from studycafe_pay sp join usertb utb on sp.user_idx = utb.user_idx where utb.user_idx = #{user_idx} and sp.pay_status = 'PAID' union all select '멤버십' as pay_type, to_char(paynum) as pay_id, '프리미엄' as pay_name, payment_amount as pay_amount, payment_method as pay_method, to_char(payment_date, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') as pay_date, to_char(end_date, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') as end_date from membership_payment where user_idx = #{user_idx} and membership_idx = 2 order by pay_date desc ) a ) b where rnum >= #{start} and rnum <= #{end}
